scope: All 137 dosage items: 79 Med Math plus 58 standard dosage

courseStatements: Gravity flow uses volume in mL × drop factor in gtt/mL divided by minutes; round to whole drops (PDF page 12)
Pump flow uses mL divided by hours; follow specified rounding (PDF page 13)
Lecture distinguishes whole-number maintenance-fluid rates and tenths-place medication rates (PDF page 14)

limitations: For the 79 Med Math entries, the printed formula was independently evaluated; a separate complete check that each formula is derived correctly from every stem is still required.
Independent calculation validates the numeric key, not medication order appropriateness, drug administration safety, or every source citation.
No user-facing activation or final clinical approval implied.
